page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.large is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz, allocating 1 physical core and 2 hardware threads (2 vCPUs) alongside 16.0 GB of memory. This provides an 8.0 GB per core ratio. The CPU features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, with instruction set support for AVX-512 extensions including AVX-512 VNNI and BF16, alongside AES, VAES, and SHA cryptographic extensions.

The instance does not include integrated local storage and operates without bundled GPU hardware, relying on external network storage for persistent disk operations. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

Benchmark evaluations indicate sharp divergence between single-threaded capability and aggregated multi-core capacity. Single-core throughput is strong, evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 3111.99 in the top 10% tier and a Geekbench single-core score of 1962.0 in the top 25%. However, due to the two-vCPU hardware ceiling, multi-core metrics sit in the bottom 25%, with a multi-core stress-ng result of 3112.6, a Geekbench multi-core score of 2448.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 3862.41.

Memory throughput registers in the middle tier, achieving 45.05 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 26.33 GB/sec for 256 MB writes, while small cached 16 KB reads reach 153.11 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates 2.8 million Redis SET operations per second and 2.85 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, reflecting constrained parallel IOPS and core-bound limits.

Workload fit centers on lightweight services that prioritize single-thread processing speed combined with an elevated memory footprint. Relevant deployments include small in-memory caches, lightweight Redis instances, low-concurrency backend services, and background workers processing memory-heavy datasets without requiring heavy parallel compute.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.large is a memory-optimized instance featuring 2 vCPUs from a single AMD EPYC 9T34 core at 3.4 GHz and 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio. It operates on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture and supports AVX-512 vector extensions. The instance carries no local storage or bundled GPUs, relying on external block storage, and is provisioned with a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results demonstrate high single-threaded performance, with top-tier stress-ng single-core (3111.99) and strong Geekbench single-core (1962.0) scores. Conversely, total compute output is strictly bounded by its two hardware threads, resulting in lower-quartile multi-core and database benchmark scores. With memory read bandwidth of 45.05 GB/sec and 2.8 million Redis SET operations per second, this profile suits low-concurrency caching, memory-heavy microservices, and small database workloads requiring fast single-thread execution.
